scope: Post hoc reanalysis of previously completed constructed-language studies; no independent confirmation or neural mechanistic identification
decomposition: b=(m_actor+m_patient)/2; r=(m_actor-m_patient)/2; both right iff r>|b|. This is an exact algebraic reparameterization, not an explanatory discovery. Scores from two prompts are not a probe of one hidden state.
calibration: Subtract each query-specific sentence-omitted margin, already archived. Standard context-free calibration diagnostic, not a proposed novel intervention.
